messages.plugin.label: Web
messages.plugin.title: View a URL, HTML source, or a local HTML file.
messages.web.urlHint: https://example.org or a local server URL
messages.web.fileHint: report/index.html or an absolute file path
messages.web.rootHint: Defaults to the HTML file's directory
messages.web.embedHint: If the site blocks embedding or does not display, open it in your browser.
messages.web.start: Enter a URL, paste HTML, or provide a local HTML path, then choose Open. You can also select a page reference from the project.
messages.web.httpOnly: Use an http:// or https:// URL. For local files, choose Local HTML.
messages.web.oneSource: Specify only one of url, html, file, or object.
messages.web.objectMissing: The object was not found or has no supported page source.
messages.web.loadError: The page could not be loaded. Try opening it in your browser.

display.label: Web
display.title: View a URL, HTML source, or a local HTML file.
display.description: Open URLs, HTML source and local HTML files in a separate page.

params.url: HTTP or HTTPS address. Choose one of url, html, file, or object.
params.html: HTML source to render. Prefer file for long or multi-file pages.
params.file: Local .html/.htm file. Relative paths start at the database directory.
params.resource_root: Resource directory for a local page; defaults to the HTML directory. Relative references stay within it.
params.object: Object ID in the current project; reads information.html, url, or source.
